items.title: Is This the Future of Enterprise AI? | Microsoft Agent Framework Foundations | Part 1
items.author: Advancing Analytics
items.summary:
Join us for the first part of our Microsoft Agent Framework series!

James and Toyosi cover the foundations of Microsoft Agent Framework V1, how it differs to other tools, and why this release feels like a real step forward for enterprise AI. At its core, it brings Semantic Kernel and AutoGen together into a single, robust pipeline - designed to make building and managing AI systems far less fragmented.

Here’s are some key features:

1️⃣ One unified framework - middleware, telemetry, and multi-agent patterns all brought together under a single tenant.

2️⃣ Built for enterprise from the ground up - guardrails, policy enforcement, and native observability via Azure Application Insights.

3️⃣ Smarter memory handling - both session-based context and long-term memory (LTM) for more persistent, useful interactions.

4️⃣ A visual way to manage it all - dev UI for monitoring agent flows, tracking token usage, and spotting performance issues early.

5️⃣ Flexible by design - easy to migrate existing projects and run across AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.

If you’re building agentic AI (or planning to), this is a solid look at why Agent Framework V1 is quickly becoming the default choice for scalable, secure enterprise solutions. Stay tuned for part 2 next week, where we cover practical applications of the Agent Framework and four notebook demos!
